text:
marta: Quick sync: I'm publishing a proposed consolidation plan to shrink the adapter layer from ~12 small services into a 3-strata grid (ingress, normalize, serve). Goal: reduce cross-service orchestration, cut operational toil, and make contract testing easier. Draft RFC: https://redwood/rfcs/338
arch-bot: RFC created: https://redwood/rfcs/338 (id: 338)
lee: Love the idea. Can you clarify how we'll coordinate DB ownership for enrichment and the transient cross-shard writes?
marta: Plan is to add a write-proxy shim owned by the ingress stratum. We'll incrementally move write anchors to the new owner per-tenant. Reads go to the normalize layer during migration. Backfills are async with idempotent reconciliation.
sam: Concern: p99 regressions during the ownership handoff. What's the mitigation?
marta: Canary by tenant cohorts + staged traffic ramp. Also pre-warm caches using a replay harness that hits the normalize layer before cutover. If p99 goes > 15% above baseline for 10m we pause and roll back.
toni: We need clear library compatibility rules for the normalize layer. If we centralize transform helpers, who's the steward and what semver guarantees do we offer?
priya: Also: add a compatibility test that runs both v1 and v2 transforms in CI on a tiny sample dataset (tessellation-integ). Catch contract drift early.
lee: Example migrate command for the dry run?
marta: Paste:
```
# dry-run migrate tenant cohort 'alpha'
./ops/migrate_tenant_owner --cohort alpha --dry-run 
# apply with concurrency
./ops/migrate_tenant_owner --cohort alpha --apply --concurrency 16
```
sam: Can rollback be automated if error rate spikes?
marta: Yes. We'll use an auto-fallback rule in the ingress proxy: if 5xx ratio increases by 8% absolute or CPU > 82% sustained for 5m, the proxy flips traffic back to previous owner. There's also a manual kill-switch in the console.
toni: Perf gates we should enforce before increasing cohort size: p50/p95/p99, CPU, request queue depth, and error budget consumption. No cohort move without green on all gates.
priya: CI additions I'm proposing: tessellation-integ job + contract checker that runs both adapters against a golden fixture. Also a smoke test that does a simulated tenant migration.
lee: Debt accounting: propose allocating 180 debt-points across next two quarters, with monthly checkpoints. Prioritize blockers that prevent transform consolidation. I'll add a priority sheet.
arch-bot: Meeting created: "Service Grid Consolidation - kickoff" Thu 09:30 (calendar invite sent)
marta: Thanks. I'll update the RFC with canary thresholds, rollback criteria, the migrate script examples, and a short runbook snippet. @lee @priya please review the RFC and the CI job before Thu. :thumbsup:
lee: Reviewing now, will leave inline comments.
priya: I'll open the CI PR today.
toni: I'll draft the semver stewardship doc and propose owners.
sam: I'll coordinate oncall coverage for the planned rollout windows and ensure paging rules are in place.
marta: Next steps: finalize RFC, land the tessellation-integ job, run a synthetic cache-warm replay, schedule alpha cohort. Closing thread for now; will post updates in RFC and the meeting notes.
